title.en: Check the rules for your work

scope.en: Course syllabi and instructors determine AI use in coursework; CCID access to Google Gemini is governed by data-risk classification (no High Risk data) and does not grant assessment permission, while held disciplinary appeal day-counts remain excluded pending primary PDF verification.
scope.zh: 课程大纲与任课教师决定课程作业中的AI使用规则；凭CCID使用Google Gemini须遵守数据风险分级（严禁输入高风险数据）且不等于作业许可，暂缓记录中的申诉天数在核实原始PDF规章前不作展示。

do.en: Read your course and assignment AI instructions.
do.zh: 阅读课程和作业 AI 说明。

do.en: Use CCID Gemini only within applicable data restrictions.
do.zh: 通过 CCID 使用 Gemini 时仍遵守数据分类限制。

dont.en: Do not share data classified high risk with AI tools.
dont.zh: 不要将高风险数据输入 AI 工具。

dont.en: Do not assume Gemini access authorizes assessment use.
dont.zh: 不要将 Gemini 使用权当作作业许可。

evidence.quote: This includes misuse, for academic advantage, of sites or tools, including artificial intelligence applications, translation software or sites, and tutorial services, which claim to support student learning.

coursework.en: AI permission is set by instructors or programs for the particular course or assignment.
coursework.zh: AI 使用许可由教师或项目就具体课程、作业决定。
coursework.meaningEn: Student Academic Integrity and IST AI guidance; instructors determine whether and how generative AI may be used in each course and assignment.
coursework.meaningZh: 学生学术诚信及信息技术（IST）AI指引；任课教师决定每门课程及作业是否允许以及如何使用生成式AI。

exams.en: No independently verified university-wide AI exam permission or prohibition in this review.
exams.zh: 本轮未独立核实全校考试 AI 许可或禁止条款。
exams.meaningEn: No separate university-wide exam AI clause was independently obtained; follow course and exam instructions.
exams.meaningZh: 未独立取得全校统一的考试AI专门条款；须严格遵守所在课程及考场说明。

disclosure.en: Check the particular assessment for disclosure and citation instructions; a uniform formula has not been verified.
disclosure.zh: 应核查具体任务的披露及引注要求；未证实全校统一格式。
disclosure.meaningEn: Course-level disclosure expectations set by instructors in syllabi and assignment briefs; no single university-wide form was verified.
disclosure.meaningZh: 由任课教师在课程大纲及作业说明中设定披露要求；未核得全校统一的强制披露表格。

privacy_data.en: CCID Gemini is institutionally approved for defined data use; high-risk data must not be shared, and other tools are not authorized for university data.
privacy_data.zh: CCID Gemini 获机构批准用于限定数据用途；高风险数据不得共享，其他工具未获机构数据使用授权。
privacy_data.meaningEn: IST generative AI privacy and data-risk rules; never share High Risk data with AI tools even when signed in with a campus CCID.
privacy_data.meaningZh: IST生成式AI隐私与数据风险规则；即使使用校内CCID登录，也严禁向AI工具输入高风险（High Risk）数据。

approved_tools.en: Gemini is identified for institutional data use, which does not grant student assignment permission. NotebookLM entitlement needs fresh verification.
approved_tools.zh: Gemini 获指定机构数据用途批准，不等于作业获准；NotebookLM 当前资格尚待再核。
approved_tools.meaningEn: Google Gemini institutional access via campus CCID; tool availability never overrides instructor restrictions on coursework.
approved_tools.meaningZh: 凭校园CCID访问学校提供的Google Gemini；工具可用性绝不超越或豁免任课教师对课程作业的限制。

research_publication.en: Grant-development guidance was located in historical tracker evidence, but its full current text was not independently obtained.
research_publication.zh: 科研资助申请指导只获既有 Tracker 线索，未独立取得当期原文。
research_publication.meaningEn: Full current university-wide research publication AI clauses were not independently obtained in this bundle.
research_publication.meaningZh: 本批资料中未独立取回现行完整的全校科研出版AI专门条款。

academic_integrity.en: Misuse of AI applications for academic advantage can fall under contract cheating; outcomes require separate formal procedures.
academic_integrity.zh: 为获取不当学术优势滥用 AI 应用可能涉及代写等违规，处分仍须依正式程序。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: Student Academic Misconduct Policy Appendix A (unauthorized AI use for academic advantage may fall under contract cheating); specific appeal day counts in historical checklists remain held.
academic_integrity.meaningZh: 《学生学术不端政策》附录A（未经授权使用AI获取学术优势可能构成代写/合同作弊）；历史清单中的具体申诉工作日天数仍予暂缓。

teaching_guidance.en: The university discourages AI detection applications and requires privacy/security review for department or faculty exceptions.
teaching_guidance.zh: 学校不建议使用 AI 检测应用；院系例外须经过隐私与安全审查。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: Centre for Teaching and Learning (CTL) guidance encouraging explicit syllabus communication of AI expectations.
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 教学中心（CTL）指引，鼓励教师在课程大纲中明确说明AI使用预期与边界。

security_procurement.en: Gemini approval applies to university data under the published data-safety guide; other services are not thereby approved.
security_procurement.zh: Gemini 机构数据许可受数据安全指南约束，不得外推其他服务获批准。
security_procurement.meaningEn: IST vendor review and data-protection rules for institutional AI services.
security_procurement.meaningZh: IST针对校内AI服务的供应商安全审查与数据保护规定。
